   real(dp) :: x(101)

! Solve x**2 - 2 = 0 with Brent's method.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
contains
   function equation(me, x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x - 2.0_wp
   end function equation
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use audit_functions, only: equation
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, residual
   integer :: status
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   call solver%initialize(equation, rtol=1.0e-12_wp)
   call solver%solve(0.0_wp, 2.0_wp, x, residual, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'nonfinite root'
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(x - sqrt(2.0_wp)) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect root'
   print '(a,f15.12)', 'PASS roots-fortran sqrt(2)=', x
end program demo

source:
! Interpolate linear data and verify an interior value.
program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use pchip_module, only: dpchim, dpchfe
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(3), f(1,3), d(1,3), query(1), answer(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: skip
   x = [0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 2.0_wp]
   f(1,:) = 2*x + 1
   call dpchim(3, x, f, d, 1, status)
   if (status < 0) error stop 'derivative calculation failed'
   skip = .false.
   query = 0.5_wp
   call dpchfe(3, x, f, d, 1, skip, 1, query, answer, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer(1))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolation'
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(answer(1) - 2.0_wp) > 1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect interpolation'
   print '(a,f8.4)', 'PASS pchip value=', answer(1)
end program demo

source:
module ode_functions
   use dop853_module, only: dop853_class, wp => dop853_wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine decay(me, x, y, derivative)
      class(dop853_class), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x, y(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: derivative(:)
      derivative = -y
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use ode_functions
   implicit none
   type(dop853_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x, y(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: initialized
   x = 0.0_wp
   y = 1.0_wp
   call solver%initialize(n=1, fcn=decay, status_ok=initialized)
   if (.not. initialized) error stop 'initialization failed'
   call solver%integrate(x, y, 1.0_wp, [1.e-10_wp], [1.e-10_wp], 0, status)
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(y(1)-exp(-1.0_wp)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'incorrect ODE solution'
   print *, 'y(1) for dy/dx=-y:', y
   print *, 'PASS dop853'
end program main

description: Nonlinear equation solvers and nonlinear least-squares fitting.
source:
module equations
   use minpack_module, only: wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine residual(n, x, fvec, iflag)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: fvec(n)
      integer, intent(inout) :: iflag
      fvec = [x(1)**2-2.0_wp, x(2)-3.0_wp]
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use minpack_module, only: hybrd1
   use equations
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(2), fvec(2), work(19)
   integer :: status
   x = [1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
   call hybrd1(residual, 2, x, fvec, 1.e-10_wp, status, work, size(work))
   if (status /= 1 .or. maxval(abs(fvec)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'nonlinear solve failed'
   print *, 'Solution (sqrt(2), 3):', x
   print *, 'PASS minpack'
end program main

program main
   use lbfgsb_module, only: setulb, wp => lbfgsp_wp
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=2, m=5
   real(wp) :: x(n), lower(n), upper(n), f, g(n), wa(2*m*n+5*n+11*m*m+8*m), dsave(29)
   integer :: bounds(n), iwa(3*n), isave(44), iteration
   logical :: lsave(4)
   character(60) :: task, csave
   x = 0.0_wp
   lower = -1.0_wp
   upper = 1.0_wp
   bounds = 2
   task = 'START'
   ! The unconstrained minimum is (2,2); the bounded minimum is (1,1).
   do iteration = 1, 100
      call setulb(n,m,x,lower,upper,bounds,f,g,1.e7_wp,1.e-8_wp, &
         wa,iwa,task,-1,csave,lsave,isave,dsave)
      if (task(1:2) == 'FG') then
         f = sum((x-2.0_wp)**2)
         g = 2*(x-2.0_wp)
      else if (task(1:5) /= 'NEW_X') then
         exit
      end if
   end do
   if (task(1:4) /= 'CONV' .or. maxval(abs(x-1.0_wp)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'incorrect optimum'
   print *, 'Bounded minimum at:', x
   print *, 'PASS lbfgsb'
end program

   data(:,1) = [-2.0_rk,-1.0_rk,0.0_rk,1.0_rk,2.0_rk]

program main

   integer, parameter :: degree=3
   real(wp) :: coefficients(4)=[1._wp,-6._wp,11._wp,-6._wp]
   real(wp) :: re(degree), im(degree), residual, expected
   complex(wp) :: z, value
   integer :: status, i, j
   ! x**3 - 6*x**2 + 11*x - 6 has roots 1, 2, 3.
   call polyroots(degree,coefficients,re,im,status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'root solver failed'
   do i=1,degree
      z=cmplx(re(i),im(i),kind=wp); value=cmplx(coefficients(1),0._wp,kind=wp)
      do j=2,degree+1
         value=value*z+coefficients(j)
      end do
      residual=abs(value)
      if (residual > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'large polynomial residual'
      print *, 'Root and residual:',z,residual
   end do
   do j=1,3
      expected=real(j,wp)
      if (minval(abs(cmplx(re,im,kind=wp)-expected)) > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'missing root'
   end do
   print *, 'PASS polyroots-fortran'
end program main

   if (rc /= SQLITE_OK) error stop 'cannot prepare query'
   rc=sqlite3_step(statement)
   if (rc /= SQLITE_ROW) error stop 'missing query result'
   count=sqlite3_column_int(statement,0)
   average=sqlite3_column_double(statement,1)
   if (count /= 5 .or. abs(average-3.d0)>1.d-12) error stop 'incorrect query result'
   print *, 'Observation count and average:',count,average
   rc=sqlite3_step(statement)
   if (rc /= SQLITE_DONE) error stop 'unexpected additional row'
   rc=sqlite3_finalize(statement)
   if (rc /= SQLITE_OK) error stop 'cannot finalize query'
   rc=sqlite3_close(db)
   if (rc /= SQLITE_OK) error stop 'cannot close database'
   print *, 'PASS fortran-sqlite3'
end program main

description: Distances, bearings and geodetic coordinate transformations on spheres and ellipsoids.
source:
program main
   use geodesic_module, only: inverse, direct, wp => geodesic_wp
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: a=6378137._wp, f=1._wp/298.257223563_wp
   real(wp) :: distance, azimuth1, azimuth2, arc, reduced, scale12, scale21, area
   real(wp) :: latitude, longitude, final_bearing
   ! Equatorial quarter-circle: distance must equal pi*a/2.
   call inverse(a,f,0._wp,0._wp,0._wp,90._wp,distance,azimuth1,azimuth2, &
      0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
   if (abs(distance-acos(-1._wp)*a/2)>1.e-6_wp) error stop 'incorrect equatorial distance'
   ! London to New York, with a direct/inverse round trip.
   call inverse(a,f,51.5074_wp,-0.1278_wp,40.7128_wp,-74.0060_wp, &
      distance,azimuth1,azimuth2,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
   if (distance < 5.58e6_wp .or. distance > 5.59e6_wp) error stop 'incorrect city distance'
   call direct(a,f,51.5074_wp,-0.1278_wp,azimuth1,distance,0,latitude,longitude, &
      final_bearing,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
   if (abs(latitude-40.7128_wp)>1.e-8_wp .or. abs(longitude+74.0060_wp)>1.e-8_wp) &
      error stop 'failed geodesic round trip'
   print *, 'London to New York (km):',distance/1000
   print *, 'Initial and final bearings (degrees):',azimuth1,azimuth2
   print *, 'PASS geodesic-fortran'
end program main

description: Stochastic global optimization by simulated annealing with bounds and reproducible seeds.
source:
module objective_module
   use simulated_annealing_module, only: simulated_annealing_type, dp => simann_wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine objective(me,x,value,status)
      class(simulated_annealing_type), intent(inout) :: me
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: value
      integer, intent(out) :: status
      ! Rastrigin function: global minimum is zero at (0,0).
      value=sum(x*x+10._dp*(1._dp-cos(2*acos(-1._dp)*x)))
      status=0
   end subroutine objective
end module objective_module
program main
   use objective_module
   use iso_fortran_env, only: output_unit
   implicit none
   type(simulated_annealing_type) :: solver
   real(dp) :: x(2), best(2), step(2), temperature, value
   integer :: accepted, evaluations, status
   x=[2.5_dp,-1.5_dp]; step=1._dp; temperature=20._dp
   call solver%initialize(objective,2,[-5._dp,-5._dp],[5._dp,5._dp],[2._dp,2._dp], &
      .false.,1.e-8_dp,20,10,4,200000,0,1,2,1,0.1_dp,output_unit)
   call solver%optimize(x,0.85_dp,temperature,step,best,value,accepted,evaluations,status)
   print *, 'Optimization status, point and value:',status,best,value
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'annealing did not converge'
   if (value > 1.e-5_dp .or. maxval(abs(best))>1.e-3_dp) error stop 'incorrect global minimum'
   print *, 'Best point:',best
   print *, 'Objective and evaluations:',value,evaluations
   print *, 'PASS simulated-annealing'
end program main
